justification: Inspected core/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/hotthrow/HotThrowFinder.java and HotThrowResult.java, plus the only incoming user found, core/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/toplist/HotThrowTopListVisitable.java. The package contains just 2 classes and has only 1 direct incoming dependency (from toplist), while HotThrowFinder depends on several broader packages (core, compilation, model, model.bytecode, util, and freelogj). This makes the package itself relatively unstable, so it is not a stable package depending on less-stable packages.
